wylie: [d23] ji zhig ltar yang dag par skyes pa na de nyid gong nas gong du khyad par du gyur pa'i stobs kyis rnam par rtog pa'i sa bon rims {%rim} kyis spangs te, mthar rnal 'byor pas shes bya'i sgrib pa thams cad yang dag par spong ngo
english: Once a person though has been able to engender, within themselves, these experiences in their pure form, in the proper way, then the experiences continue on to higher and higher levels—more and more extraordinary—until they achieve a certain power.  And then this power allows the practitioner to rid themselves, gradually, of the mental seeds for imagining that things exist in a way they cannot.  In the end, the adept who undertakes these deep practices is able to rid themselves, perfectly, of each and every obstacle to omniscience.
